evidence_quotes:
HYDRO-BOOST –  Converts hydraulic power from the steering pump to mechanical power to the
master cylinder, providing power assist during braking.
statements.reason: The passage instead says hydro-boost converts steering-pump hydraulic power to mechanical power for the master cylinder, assisting braking.
statements.statement: In the steering-system description, the hydro-boost unit hydraulically amplifies the driver's steering input, multiplying force applied to the steering wheel to assist in turning the vehicle's wheels.

evidence_quotes:
